name: Senna Hills
title: Window Cleaning in Senna Hills, Austin TX | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning in Senna Hills north of Bee Cave Road. Pure water glass at $10 per window for late 1990s Eanes ISD homes, with screens and tracks done too.
intro: Senna Hills is an ungated Eanes ISD subdivision north of Bee Cave Road, off Senna Hills Drive. CleanzATX cleans windows here, and homes of this age often have glass and screens that deserve a proper reset.

sections.h2: What Senna Hills homes are like
paragraphs: About 300 homes make up Senna Hills, mostly built in the late 1990s, a short drive from downtown Bee Cave. The Senna Hills HOA covers the neighborhood, and prices run about $800K to $1.8M. It is not gated, so access is simple.
Homes from this era tend to have a lot of traditional windows with grids or divided panes, and the trees planted back then are fully grown now.

sections.h2: What Senna Hills windows deal with
paragraphs: After more than twenty years, hard water can leave a permanent mark. Sprinklers that sat close to the glass for years often leave etching, which looks like a haze that will not wipe off. We treat mineral deposits at $10 per pane, and we tell you straight if a pane is past saving.

Mature trees also shed into the screens and the aluminum tracks. Divided panes add extra edges to clean, which is where pure water pays off, since it rinses into the corners without leaving soap residue.

Without a gate, we can usually fit a Senna Hills job into a day when we are already on Bee Cave Road. We ask for photos of any windows you are worried about, so the quote covers hard water and screens. Older houses can also have siding, stucco or a roof that has gone green, and house and roof soft washing are worth a look.

For a 3,000 square foot house, exterior windows are about $300 at $0.10 per sq ft. Exterior time is roughly two and a quarter to three hours, with interior glass cleaned by hand in about an hour and a half.

why: Late 1990s glass often needs hard water treatment, and we assess it honestly.
Divided panes rinse clean with pure water and no soap residue.
No gate to arrange, so booking is quick and flexible.
Screens and tracks are reset in the same visit if you want.

faq.q: My windows look hazy after years of sprinklers. Can you fix that?
faq.a: Often yes. Mineral film comes off with hard water removal at $10 per pane. Deep etching in the glass cannot always be reversed, so we tell you what to expect before we start.

faq.q: How much does a Senna Hills home cost?
faq.a: Outside glass is $10 per window or about $0.10 per sq ft, so a 3,000 square foot home lands near $300. Both sides is $15 per window. Minimum job is $200.

faq.q: Do you clean windows with grids or divided panes?
faq.a: Yes. Pure water rinses into corners and grid edges without leaving soap film, which makes divided panes dry clean. Interior is done by hand with squeegees and cloths.

faq.q: Can you do screens and tracks?
faq.a: Yes. Screens are $5, with full screens $10 and solar screens $15. Tracks are $5. Higher plans include a free yearly screen cleaning and hard water removal on up to 5 windows each visit.
Most Senna Hills jobs get on the calendar within about two weeks. Text us for a quote, usually back within the hour in business hours. We hold off on promising a date until you accept the price.
